messages:
rachel: Quick sync after last week's postmortem on the throughput/regression cluster. We saw recurring short p99 blips during shard handoffs. Need owners, timelines, and SLO text we can surface to customers.

omar: I'll take shard-autoscale tuning. Plan: recreate shard handoff in staging, measure tail latency, propose cooldowns. ETA 6 business days.

jin: I'll own the KV-cache heuristics and a short-term decrease in eviction aggressiveness. Aim to open PR in 10 days.

carla: I'll own dashboards & customer-visible SLO wording. Proposal: change text-gen p99 SLA to a 30-day rolling window and add a throughput SLO (p95 >= 110 qps per shard during peak). Temp p99 target: 320ms (down from 350) until fixes roll out.

rachel: For temporary SLO, let's add rollback criteria: automatic rollback if error-budget burn > 25% in a 24h window OR p99 > 600ms for >10m. Also require dashboards + alerts in prod before we publish.

omar: Added a replayable staging test to ticket. Will request a dev GPU for profiling.

slo-bot: Created ticket SRE-6750: "followup/shard-handoff-slo-updates" with checklist and owners.

jin: Draft alert for p99 spike (5m):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.32
```
I'll iterate after staging numbers.

carla: I'll add panels: per-shard p50/p90/p99, shard qps, and a 7-day rolling error-budget burn. Will push JSON to the ticket in 48h.

rachel: Milestones: dashboards+alerts by 1999070000 (48h), autoscale PR by 1999510000 (6 days), KV PR by 2000060000 (10 days). Weekly 15m reviews for 3 weeks to monitor recurrence.

omar: Sounds good. I'll update SRE-6750 with cooldown numbers and rollback steps.

jin: Will include an integration test simulating shard rebalance.

carla: Draft SLA blurb to legal + customer comms: "Temporary SLO amendment: text-gen p99 target = 320ms, 30-day rolling window, subject to rollback on sustained error-budget burn. See SRE-6750 for details."

rachel: Thanks team. After ticket has dashboards + rollback criteria, I'll approve the temporary SLO and notify product/comms. :white_check_mark:
